_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
macOS Cmd+V reaches the browser when an app asks for the kitty keyboard protocol (xterm). Terminals render with xterm; the browser says it runs on a Mac (navigator.platform "MacIntel"). window.cmdKeydowns records, in order, {key, prevented} for every keydown with the Meta key held (other than Meta itself), as the window saw it once handlers had run. The test seeded a conversation at /c/term-kitty, whose directory holds keys.sh, which asks for the kitty keyboard protocol the way nvim does, prints "kitty-ready", then reports raw input (the terminal's reply included) up to "q" as keys=<input, shell-quoted>. "The input" is [data-testid="message-input"]. "The terminal input" is the visible terminal's input, '.terminal-panel-content [data-terminal-id][style*="display: block"] textarea[aria-label="Terminal input"]' (other terminals' inputs are hidden); to type into it, focus it with an eval (.focus()), then use type steps, which type key by key, and press_key for Enter or Control+d. To choose a terminal menu item, click the button with aria-label exactly "Terminal menu", then the button with exactly that text inside ".overflow-menu-panel" (two real clicks). 
1. Navigate to /c/term-kitty. Fill the input with "!bash keys.sh" and click [data-testid="send-button"].
2. Retry the following steps as one block until they pass (timeout 15s): choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input" (both clicks inside the block); then the input's value must contain "kitty-ready" (eval with expect true).
3. Fill the input with "".
4. Focus the terminal input (eval .focus()), then press, each with press_key: Meta+v, Meta+c, Meta+l, q.
5. There should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-success".
6. Choose the terminal menu item "Insert all output into input". The input's value should contain "keys=''" (the program read nothing before the q: no key reports and no protocol reply).
7. window.cmdKeydowns must be exactly [{"key":"v","prevented":false},{"key":"c","prevented":false},{"key":"l","prevented":false}] (check once).
